offering_description.value: MasTec builds and upgrades infrastructure for renewable energy developers, electric utilities, telecom carriers, pipeline operators and public agencies. Its crews engineer, install and maintain wind, solar and battery storage facilities, power lines, fiber and wireless networks, and pipelines. It also builds roads and other heavy civil and industrial infrastructure.

primary_services.value: renewable energy and battery storage construction; electric transmission and distribution construction; fiber and wireless network deployment; pipeline construction and maintenance; heavy civil and industrial construction

customer_segment.value: B2B: Renewable energy developers, electric utilities, telecom carriers, pipeline operators and industrial companies; B2G: Transportation agencies, municipalities and other public infrastructure owners

end_markets.value: renewable energy and storage; electric utilities; telecommunications; oil and gas; transportation and civil infrastructure

revenue_model.value: project or contract: Engineering, procurement, construction, installation and ongoing maintenance under project contracts and master service agreements

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Uses labor, equipment and materials to build and maintain infrastructure for utilities, developers, carriers, pipeline operators and public agencies

geography_served.value: North America: Primarily the United States, with operations in Canada

specialization.value: related lines: Renewable energy, electric grid, telecom, pipeline, heavy civil and industrial construction

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Direct bids, negotiated project awards and master service agreements with infrastructure owners

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Construction is subject to worker safety rules, environmental and land use permits, and utility and pipeline safety standards.
